jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Vi har nu ett nytt behov och söker därför en konsult och kollega med nedan kvalifikationer. Tjänsten är en del av vår konsultverksamhet vilket innebär att du blir anställd av oss och arbetar hos kund alt. interna projekt och åtaganden.

 **Din profil (Skall krav)**  

* Behärskar SQL och Python
* Har erfarenhet av datamodellering och semantiska lager, samt kännedom om verktyg som exempelvis Git, BigQuery och dbt
* Ligger i framkant vad gäller AI\-verktyg och hur AI kan användas i analysarbetet
* Har erfarenhet av att använda LLM:er som en del av ditt analysarbete, samt en god förståelse för dess styrkor och begränsningar
* Praktisk erfarenhet av att bygga analysflöden med LLM:er
* Har erfarenhet av explorativ analys och att arbeta hypotesdrivet med data
* Har erfarenhet av att arbete med datakvalité, validering och felsökning
* Vana vid att visualisera och kommunicera data genom exempelvis visualiseringsverktyg eller egenbyggda gränssnitt för analys.

  

**Meriterande**  

* Erfarenhet av utveckling (FE och/eller BE)
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med realtidsdata, stora mängder eventdata eller strömmande data
* Erfarenhet av användarnära digitala tjänster och streamingtjänster

  

**Sista ansökningdatum:** 05\-10\-2026

jobs.title: Commercial Analyst, Digital Partners
jobs.description:
*Do you want to help shape the future of Pandora's digital growth? Are you analytically minded, commercially curious, and motivated by turning insights into strategic opportunities? Then you might be the new Commercial Analyst, Digital Partners we're looking for to join our Global eCommerce team in Copenhagen!*

  

In this role, you will play a key part in identifying, evaluating, and advancing new Digital Partner opportunities across global markets. Working day to day with the Business Development Manager, you will provide the analytical foundation, business cases, and stakeholder coordination needed to support strategic decision\-making and unlock new growth opportunities for Pandora.

  

As Commercial Analyst, Digital Partners, you will support the development and expansion of Pandora's Digital Partner ecosystem, including marketplaces, multi\-brand retailers, and other strategic partners.


You will combine commercial analysis, financial modelling, market research, and stakeholder management to help evaluate opportunities and support their successful execution. This role offers broad exposure across markets and functions, while providing valuable experience working with senior stakeholders and strategic initiatives.

  

**Key responsibilities**


Drive opportunity identification and pipeline development


* Support the identification and qualification of new Digital Partner opportunities across regions and markets
* Conduct market sizing and commercial assessments to evaluate growth potential
* Build and maintain a structured opportunity pipeline and prioritization framework
* Assess partner attractiveness across commercial, operational, and brand dimensions
Build business cases and generate commercial insights


* Develop business cases, financial models, and investment recommendations for new and existing partner initiatives
* Gather and synthesize inputs from Finance, Operations, Technology, and regional stakeholders
* Build and continuously improve performance reporting and insights to support business case delivery, planning, and growth decisions.
* Support senior decision\-making with robust data\-driven analysis
Support partner engagement and cross\-functional execution


* Prepare materials, analyses, and recommendations for partner discussions and business reviews
* Coordinate information requests and stakeholder inputs during evaluation and launch phases
* Track actions, dependencies, and milestones across multiple workstreams
* Support readiness assessments and post\-launch performance reviews
Deliver market intelligence and strategic insights


* Monitor developments across e\-commerce, marketplaces, and digital retail partnerships
* Conduct competitor and market research across categories and regions
* Create concise insights and recommendations to support strategic discussions
* Maintain visibility on emerging digital business models and industry best practices
Enable senior stakeholder decision\-making


* Prepare presentations, dashboards, and executive materials for leadership forums
* Translate complex analyses into clear and actionable recommendations
* Support discussions involving senior stakeholders across the global organization
* Ensure decisions, learnings, and documentation are captured and shared effectively
**What we’re looking for**


You are naturally curious and enjoy solving complex business problems through data and analysis. You are highly structured, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and can balance attention to detail with a broader strategic perspective. Most importantly, you are motivated by creating clarity from complexity and enjoy collaborating across teams to turn opportunities into tangible business results. We imagine that you have:


* 2\-4 years of experience within Business Development, Strategy, Management Consulting, Commercial Finance, E\-commerce, or a similar analytical commercial role
* A relevant degree within Business, Economics, Finance, Strategy, or a related field
* Strong analytical capabilities and experience working with financial models and business cases
* Advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to present complex topics in a structured and concise manner
* A proactive and collaborative mindset with the ability to work across multiple stakeholders and functions
* Professional proficiency in English
Experience with e\-commerce, digital marketplaces, fashion, jewellery, or consumer goods is considered an advantage, but not a requirement.

  

**Your new team**


As part of Pandora's Global eCommerce organization, you will join a team shaping the future of digital growth for the world's largest jewellery brand.


The Digital Partners team is responsible for accelerating Pandora's growth through marketplaces, multi\-brand retailers, social commerce, online presence of distributors and other strategic digital partnerships.


Working across markets, functions, and senior stakeholders, we identify new growth opportunities, build business cases, and help bring innovative digital partner models to life.

  

In this role, you will work day to day with the Business Development Manager, Digital Partners, while collaborating with colleagues across functions such as Commercial Finance, Global Ecom, Technology, Legal, and regional eCommerce teams. You will gain broad exposure to strategic initiatives and play an active role in supporting decisions that shape Pandora's future digital growth agenda.

  

**Additional information**


* **Global Career Band:**5B
**Did we get your attention?**
  

If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

  

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

  

**Icing on the cake**

jobs.title: BI & Business Analyst
jobs.description:
29\. september 2026
***Vi søger en analytisk stærk og forretningsorienteret BI \& Business Analyst, der brænder for at omsætte data til værdifulde indsigter og skabe sammenhæng mellem forretningens behov og de tekniske løsninger.***


I rollen bliver du en central sparringspartner for både Commercial, Production, IT og Finance. Du får en nøglerolle i at forstå forretningens udfordringer, identiﬁcere behov og omsætte dem til brugbare BI\-løsninger i tæt samarbejde med både interne interessenter og vores eksterne BI\-leverandør. Du kommer til at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem data, teknologi og forretning, hvor din evne til at skabe overblik og forståelse bliver afgørende for virksomhedens fortsatte udvikling.

  

  

**CFO, Anders Baltzer Thygesen udtaler:** *"Noget af det bedste ved at arbejde hos os er samarbejdet på tværs af organisationen. Som BI \& Business Analyst kommer du til at arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger fra mange forskellige funktioner og får mulighed for at påvirke, hvordan vi bruger data til at udvikle forretningen. Du bliver en vigtig del af vores rejse mod at blive endnu mere datadrevne, og dine idéer og indsigter vil blive lyttet til."*

  

  

**Dine ansvarsområder**


Som BI \& Business Analyst får du ansvar for at understøtte organisationen med analyser og indsigter, der styrker beslutningsgrundlaget på tværs af virksomheden. Du bliver den naturlige forbindelse mellem forretningen og BI\-udviklingen og får en aktiv rolle i at sikre, at løsningerne skaber reel værdi for brugerne.


Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:


* At indsamle, udfordre og kvaliﬁcere krav fra forretningen
* At omsætte forretningsmæssige behov til konkrete analyse\- og rapporteringsløsninger At udvikle dashboards, rapporter og visualiseringer, der understøtter ledelsens og organisationens beslutninger
* At samarbejde med vores eksterne BI\-partner omkring datamodeller og back\-end udvikling At bidrage til den løbende udvikling og optimering af virksomhedens BI\-landskab
* At identiﬁcere muligheder for bedre udnyttelse af data på tværs af systemer, processer og funktioner
  

  

**Hvem er du?**


Vi forestiller os, at du har et par års erfaring inden for Business Intelligence, analyse eller datavisualisering og motiveres af at skabe forretningsværdi gennem data. Du er nysgerrig af natur og trives med at sætte dig ind i nye problemstillinger, systemer og processer.


Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:


* Har arbejdet med et eller ﬂere front\-end BI\-værktøjer
* Har erfaring med Power BI og gerne DAX
* Har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for eksempelvis Finance, Business Intelligence, IT eller lignende
* Har en grundlæggende forståelse for systemarkitektur og databaser Har kendskab til SQL og relationelle databaser
  

  

Det vigtigste er dog, at du har en stærk forretningsforståelse og evner at omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til løsninger, der skaber værdi for brugerne. Du kommunikerer let med forskellige interessenter og formår at bygge bro mellem tekniske muligheder og forretningsmæssige behov.

  

  

**Som person**


Du er struktureret og analytisk i din tilgang, men samtidig nysgerrig og initiativrig. Du motiveres af at ﬁnde forbedringsmuligheder og udfordre eksisterende arbejdsgange, når der er potentiale for at skabe bedre løsninger.


Vi forestiller os, at du:


* Er proaktiv og tager ejerskab for dine opgaver
* Er stærk til at skabe relationer og samarbejde på tværs af organisationen
* Er nysgerrig på forretningen og interesseret i at forstå, hvad der driver værdiskabelsen Trives med både selvstændigt arbejde og teamwork
  

  

**Vi tilbyder**


Hos os bliver du en del af et solidt og engageret Finance team, og du får en central rolle med stor berøringsﬂade på tværs af organisationen og mulighed for at gøre en mærkbar forskel. Du kommer til at have dit virke i et fagligt stærkt miljø, hvor samarbejde, udvikling og videndeling er en naturlig del af hverdagen.


Vi tilbyder blandt andet:


* En rolle med stor synlighed og indﬂydelse
* Mulighed for at præge udviklingen af virksomhedens BI\-setup
* Tæt samarbejde med både forretningen og eksterne specialister
* Gode faglige og personlige udviklingsmuligheder
* Et uformelt og dynamisk arbejdsmiljø med fokus på samarbejde og resultater
  

* ️Lyder det som noget for dig?


Hvis du motiveres af at skabe værdi gennem data og trives i rollen som bindeled mellem mennesker, processer og teknologi, ser vi frem til at høre fra dig.


Og har du spørgsmål om stillingen, så ræk gerne ud til CFO, Anders Baltzer Thygesen på mail ANTH@bellagroup.dk  



  

***Hvem er vi?***


*Bellagroup er en af Danmarks førende hospitality\-virksomheder og driver hoteller, venues, konferencer og events i København. Vores B Corp\-certificerede forretning bygger på formålet “Hosting Moments That Matter”. Hvert år byder vi mere end 1 million gæster fra hele verden velkommen.*


*På tværs af Bella Center Copenhagen og vores tre internationale hoteller – Copenhagen Marriott Hotel, AC Hotel Bella Sky Copenhagen og Crowne Plaza Copenhagen Towers – råder vi over næsten 1\.600 værelser samt mere end 65\.000 m² fleksible arealer, møde\- og eventfaciliteter.*


*Hos Bellagroup starter det hele med mennesker – vores gæster, vores kolleger og de samarbejdspartnere, vi skaber oplevelser sammen med. Det er derfor vi siger: ”When you’re here, it matters”.*


#### **Lokationer**


Bella Center Copenhagen

jobs.title: Country Data Analyst - IKEA Denmark (Service Office in Taastrup)
jobs.description:
"You care about making a positive impact in the world. You understand greatness requires thinking differently. An inclusive and accepting work environment is important to you.



A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."



* Location
Taastrup
* Employment type
Full Time Permanent
* Department
Business \& Consumer Insights \& Analytics
* Deadline
2026\-10\-13

  
Candidate profile (title) Who you are
Candidate profile (text) \- Default language You are a curious and collaborative Data Analyst who enjoys turning data into clear, reliable and useful insights for the business. You are motivated by building strong data foundations, creating dashboards and analyses that people trust, and helping IKEA Denmark make better and faster decisions.
  

  

Most importantly, you are motivated by creating value through data and by contributing to an inclusive team where knowledge sharing, learning and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.
  

  

We believe you bring many of the following strengths:
  

  

* Has solid experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, BI Developer or similar role
* Is highly skilled in SQL and Phython, and is comfortable working with large and complex datasets
* Has strong experience with data modelling, data transformation and creating reliable data structures for reporting and analysis
* Has practical experience with MS Fabric and Power BI, including building clear dashboards, semantic models, measures and automated reporting solutions
* Understands how to turn business needs into data requirements, analysis and user\-friendly reporting solutions
* Can translate data into clear stories that help stakeholders understand performance, identify gaps and decide what to do next
* Works in a structured and proactive way, with the ability to prioritise and drive tasks forward independently
* Is curious about AI and motivated by exploring how AI can improve the way we work with data, analysis and decision\-making
* Enjoys working closely with stakeholders and being part of a collaborative team where knowledge sharing, curiosity and continuous improvement are important

  

You do not need to tick every box to be successful in this role. If you are excited about the opportunity and believe your experience can contribute to our team, we would love to hear from you.
Key responsibilities (title) A day in your life with us
Key responsibilities (text) In this role, you will help IKEA Denmark turn data into trusted insights and decision support. You will work closely with the Insights \& Analytics team and stakeholders across the Danish organisation to understand business needs, build strong data solutions and make performance easier to understand and act on.
  

  

Your work will include:
  

  

* Building and maintaining Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions that support business performance follow\-up
* Creating data models, measures and datasets that are reliable, scalable and easy to use
* Writing SQL queries to extract, transform and prepare data for analysis and reporting
* Conducting exploratory analysis to identify patterns, gaps, opportunities and business drivers
* Working closely with Insights Leaders to combine analytical findings with business and customer understanding
* Translating business questions into data requirements and clear analytical solutions
* Helping improve data quality, definitions and documentation together with the Data Governance \& Activation Leader
* Using and exploring AI\-supported ways of working to make analysis, reporting and insight generation more efficient
* Communicating findings in a simple and visual way that helps stakeholders understand what is happening, why it matters and what actions could be taken
Team vision ( title) Together as a team
Team vision (text) You will be part of the Insights \& Analytics team in IKEA Denmark, a team with a clear purpose: to help IKEA Denmark make better and faster decisions by bringing together data, insights, business understanding and customer perspectives.
  

  

Today, we are five colleagues in the team: two Insights Leaders, one Data Analysts, one Data Governance \& Activation Leader and the Insights \& Analytics Manager. We work closely together across our different areas of expertise and partner with functions across the Danish organisation.
  

  

As a team, we believe in openness, curiosity and togetherness. We have a high team spirit, and we want everyone to feel safe to share their opinion, challenge constructively and contribute with their unique perspective.
Let's connect Apply now!
Let´s connect At IKEA, we believe that diverse perspectives help us make better decisions and create better solutions. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and empowered to grow.
  

  

If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not match every qualification listed. We value different backgrounds, perspectives and ways of thinking.
  

  

If you have questions to the position, you are welcome to reach out to Insights \& Analytic Manager, Anders Jensen on anders.jensen6@ingka.ikea.com
Local section (title) Additional information
Local section (text) •Working Hours \& Contract: The position is 37\+ hours per week on a salaried contract (funktionærkontrakt), where additional hours and overtime are included in the salary.
  

* Flexible Hours: Flexible working hours (typically 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM).
* Remote Work: Opportunity to work from home up to 2 days a week.
* Compensation: Salary according to qualifications and in line with IKEA’s salary policy.

*Bellagroup er en af Danmarks førende hospitality\-virksomheder og driver hoteller, venues, konferencer og events i København. Vores B Corp\-certificerede forretning bygger på formålet “Hosting Moments That Matter”. Hvert år byder vi mere end 1 million gæster fra hele verden velkommen.*


*På tværs af Bella Center Copenhagen og vores tre internationale hoteller – Copenhagen Marriott Hotel, AC Hotel Bella Sky Copenhagen og Crowne Plaza Copenhagen Towers – råder vi over næsten 1\.600 værelser samt mere end 65\.000 m² fleksible arealer, møde\- og eventfaciliteter.*


*Hos Bellagroup starter det hele med mennesker – vores gæster, vores kolleger og de samarbejdspartnere, vi skaber oplevelser sammen med. Det er derfor vi siger: ”When you’re here, it matters”.*
